4.zh: 系統性回顧或統合分析

cases.title_zh: 研究：開放對話危機照顧未延遲復發，住院率 21% 對 44%（494 人群組隨機試驗）
cases.title_en: Open Dialogue versus treatment as usual ODDESSI trial
cases.summary_zh: Lancet Psychiatry 刊出 ODDESSI 試驗，是至今最大規模的開放對話（Open Dialogue）隨機評估。研究在英格蘭五間 NHS 精神健康機構，以基層診所群組隨機分配 494 名因危機求助的成人（開放對話組 271 人，常規治療組 223 人），追蹤兩年。主要結果顯示，兩組由危機康復後首次復發的時間無顯著差異（邊際風險比 0.95，95% 置信區間 0.67–1.32）。次要結果較有利於開放對話：精神科住院比率為 21%，常規治療組為 44%；再轉介危機照顧或二級精神健康服務的機率亦較低，自評康復、健康相關生活質素與服務滿意度較佳。嚴重不良事件共 386 宗，97% 與介入無關。研究由英國國家健康研究所資助。
cases.summary_en: The Lancet Psychiatry published the ODDESSI trial, the largest randomised evaluation of Open Dialogue to date. Across five NHS mental health trusts in England, 494 adults presenting in crisis were allocated by GP-practice cluster to Open Dialogue (n=271) or treatment as usual (n=223) and followed for two years. The primary outcome showed no significant difference in time to first relapse after recovery from the index crisis (marginal hazard ratio 0.95, 95% CI 0.67-1.32). Secondary outcomes favoured Open Dialogue: psychiatric inpatient admission was 21% versus 44% with treatment as usual, re-referral to crisis or secondary mental health services was lower, and self-rated recovery, health-related quality of life and service satisfaction were better. There were 386 serious adverse events, 97% of them unrelated to the intervention. The trial was funded by the UK National Institute for Health Research.

cases.title_zh: 統合分析：藝術活動與藝術治療可減輕兒童青少年抑鬱焦慮（100 項試驗）
cases.title_en: Arts and arts therapies mental health children young people
cases.summary_zh: eClinicalMedicine 刊出系統性回顧與統合分析，綜合 100 項隨機對照試驗（29 個國家，5 至 24 歲兒童青少年），評估藝術活動與藝術治療對心理健康的影響。結果顯示，藝術介入可減輕抑鬱（標準化平均差低 1.06，1,655 人）與焦慮（低 0.75，3,898 人），並提升幸福感（高 0.53）與生活質素（高 0.54），平均效應與已建立的非藝術心理社會介入相近。介入一個月後追蹤，抑鬱與焦慮的改善仍然存在。研究亦見生理指標改善：靜止心率平均低 4.53 次／分鐘，收縮壓平均低 4.04 毫米汞柱。最大效益見於 9 至 13 歲、多模式與主動參與的介入。研究由英國研究與創新局資助。
cases.summary_en: eClinicalMedicine published a systematic review and meta-analysis of 100 randomised controlled trials from 29 countries, assessing arts-based interventions and arts therapies for children and young people aged 5-24. Arts interventions reduced depression (standardised mean difference 1.06 lower, n=1,655) and anxiety (0.75 lower, n=3,898), and increased wellbeing (0.53 higher) and quality of life (0.54 higher), with average effects similar to those of established non-arts psychosocial interventions. Improvements in depression and anxiety persisted at follow-up of at least one month. Physiological markers also improved: resting heart rate was 4.53 beats per minute lower and systolic blood pressure 4.04 mmHg lower on average. The largest benefits were seen in 9- to 13-year-olds and in multimodal, actively participatory programmes. The work was funded by UK Research and Innovation.

cases.title_zh: 研究：冰島 70 校禁手機，青少年心理健康無明顯改善（23,938 人次）
cases.title_en: School phone bans adolescent mental health Iceland
cases.summary_zh: JAMA Network Open 研究分析冰島全國「冰島青年」調查，70 間學校、23,938 人次 13 至 15 歲青少年，橫跨 2016 年 2 月、2018 年 2 月與 2023 年 11 月三波調查。其中 22 間學校於 2018 至 2023 年間實施上課時間禁手機。差異中差異分析顯示，禁手機與抑鬱症狀、焦慮、敵意或心理幸福感均無有意義的變化：抑鬱 β=0.65（95% CI 0.01–1.30），焦慮 β=0.21，敵意 β=0.23，幸福感 β=−0.52。欺凌、同儕支援與每日屏幕時間亦無顯著變化。作者結論：單靠禁手機，未必足以在人口層面改善青少年心理健康。研究由冰島研究基金與 NordForsk 資助。
cases.summary_en: A JAMA Network Open study analysed Iceland's nationwide Youth in Iceland survey: 23,938 observations of adolescents aged 13-15 from 70 schools across three waves (February 2016, February 2018 and November 2023). Twenty-two schools introduced schoolwide mobile phone bans between 2018 and 2023. Difference-in-differences analysis found no meaningful change in depressive symptoms, anxiety, hostility or mental well-being: depressive symptoms β=0.65 (95% CI 0.01-1.30), anxiety β=0.21, hostility β=0.23, well-being β=-0.52. Bullying, peer support and daily screen time also showed no significant change. The authors conclude that school phone bans implemented alone may be insufficient to improve adolescent mental health at the population level. The work was funded by the Icelandic Research Fund and NordForsk.

cases.title_zh: RCT：自殺風險篩查陽性後跟進，成人宜電話、青少年長遠宜短訊（1,520 人）
cases.title_en: SPARC support calls versus caring texts suicide follow-up
cases.summary_zh: American Journal of Psychiatry 刊出 SPARC 實用隨機試驗，比較自殺風險篩查陽性後兩種跟進方式：實務支援電話（Instrumental Support Calls）與關懷短訊（Caring Contacts Texts）。研究在 9 間急症室與 36 間基層診所招募 723 名 12 至 17 歲青少年與 797 名 18 歲以上成人，兩組均在常規照顧上加跟進。主要結果（六個月自殺意念與行為分數）顯示，成人用電話較短訊低（調整平均差 0.50）；青少年在六個月時兩組相近，到 12 個月時短訊組較低（調整平均差 −0.64）。PCORI 摘要補充，短訊組青少年在 6 至 12 個月間自殺企圖少 2.5 倍。作者結論：最合適的跟進方式可能因年齡而異。研究由美國病人為本結果研究所（PCORI）資助。
cases.summary_en: The American Journal of Psychiatry published the SPARC pragmatic randomised trial comparing two follow-up approaches after a positive suicide-risk screen: instrumental support calls versus two-way Caring Contacts text messages. Across 9 emergency departments and 36 primary care clinics, 723 adolescents aged 12-17 and 797 adults aged 18 and over were randomised, with both arms added to usual care. At the primary 6-month time point, adults had lower suicidal ideation and behaviour scores with calls than with texts (adjusted difference in means 0.50); adolescents were similar at 6 months, but at 12 months their scores were lower with texts (adjusted difference -0.64). The PCORI summary adds that adolescents receiving texts reported 2.5 times fewer suicide attempts between 6 and 12 months. The authors conclude that the best follow-up care may vary by age. The trial was funded by the US Patient-Centered Outcomes Research Institute (PCORI).

cases.title_zh: 統合分析：精神分裂症患者用抗精神病藥，死亡與復發風險較低，但癌症、骨折、肺感染較高（68 項研究）
cases.title_en: Antipsychotic use clinical outcomes schizophrenia
cases.summary_zh: Molecular Psychiatry 刊出系統性回顧與統合分析，綜合 68 項觀察性研究、1,424,455 名精神分裂症患者，比較用抗精神病藥與不用的臨床結果。用藥與較低的全因死亡率相關（合併估計 0.64），復發風險亦較低（0.34）。另一方面，用藥與較高的癌症（1.41）、骨折（1.35）與肺部感染（1.25）風險相關，其他結果則無顯著差異。作者強調，全部研究均屬觀察性，殘餘混雜因素可能影響結果，不能作因果解讀，證據基礎有限，部分合併估計只來自少數研究。研究由中國國家自然科學基金資助，作者申報無利益衝突。
cases.summary_en: Molecular Psychiatry published a systematic review and meta-analysis of 68 observational studies covering 1,424,455 people with schizophrenia, comparing antipsychotic use with nonuse. Use was associated with lower all-cause mortality (pooled estimate 0.64) and lower relapse risk (0.34). On the other hand, use was associated with higher risks of cancer (1.41), fractures (1.35) and lung infections (1.25); other outcomes did not reach significance. The authors stress that every included study was observational, that residual confounding may shape the associations, and that the findings cannot be read as causal; the evidence base was limited, with several pooled figures resting on few studies. The work was funded by the National Natural Science Foundation of China, and the authors declare no competing interests.

cases.title_zh: 數碼心理健康介入的日常試驗：方法學展望
cases.title_en: Effective Trialing of Digital Interventions in Daily Life Mental Health Perspective
cases.summary_zh: 文章指出數碼心理健康介入常出現先導研究亮麗、隨機對照試驗卻失敗的落差。原因包括依從率低（一項涵蓋 70 項隨機對照試驗的統合分析顯示只有 34% 用戶完成全部介入）、alpha 膨脹，以及機器學習分析的時間數據洩漏。作者建議試驗期要夠長（復發自然機率至少 50%）、提高結果量度的時間精確度，並發展效度更高的數碼表型。
cases.summary_en: A Perspective in npj Digital Medicine (November 6, 2026) asks why promising pilot data for digital mental health interventions so often fail in RCTs. A meta-analysis of 70 RCTs found only 34% of users completed the full intervention, and the authors point to alpha-inflation and temporal data leakage in machine-learning analyses. They recommend longer trials (relapse probability of at least 50%), weekly ground-truth classification, and digital phenotypes with stronger construct validity.

cases.title_zh: 心理學家如何應對 AI 在心理評估中日增的角色
cases.title_en: Psychologists navigate AIs growing role in assessment
cases.summary_zh: AI 已廣泛用於心理評估報告撰寫，也開始協助產生測驗題目與在真實情境中偵測風險。專家提醒，通用聊天機械人不是 HIPAA 合規工具，不可輸入受保護健康資訊；過度依賴 AI 解讀結果可能導致誤診，作假偵測亦面臨挑戰。美國心理學會心理測驗與評估委員會已發布負責任使用 AI 的報告。
cases.summary_en: APA's Monitor on Psychology (November 1, 2026) reports on AI's growing role in psychological assessment: report writing is the most widespread use, while generative psychometrics may adapt tests in real time. Experts warn that general-purpose chatbots are not HIPAA-compliant, must not receive protected health information, and can help test-takers feign symptoms, though validity scales still catch most AI-assisted feigning. APA's Committee on Psychological Tests and Assessment has released a report on responsible AI use in assessment.

cases.title_zh: 美國七州禁止 AI 治療聊天機械人：臨床人員須知
cases.title_en: Seven states ban AI therapy chatbots
cases.summary_zh: 科羅拉多、緬因、羅德島、田納西與佛蒙特五州於 2026 年加入伊利諾與內華達，禁止 AI 治療聊天機械人。賓州醫學委員會 2026 年 5 月就 Character Technologies 的「Emilie」角色提告，是首宗以醫療執業法追究聊天機械人的案件。加州 AB 1979 要求持牌人員在使用 AI 臨床決策支援時行使獨立專業判斷，大部分條文 2027 年 1 月 1 日生效。禁令不會令病人停用聊天機械人。
cases.summary_en: Telehealth.org (November 9, 2026) reports that seven US states now ban AI therapy chatbots: Colorado, Maine, Rhode Island, Tennessee and Vermont joined Illinois and Nevada in 2026. The article also covers Pennsylvania's May 2026 lawsuit against Character Technologies over a chatbot persona posing as a psychiatrist, and California's AB 1979, which requires licensed clinicians to exercise independent judgment when using AI clinical decision support, effective January 1, 2027.

cases.title_zh: AI 聊天機械人能否成為男性心理健康的切入點
cases.title_en: AI chatbots mens mental health middle ground
cases.summary_zh: 男性佔自殺死亡人數高達八成，接受心理治療的機會卻只有女性約一半。皮尤研究中心調查發現，8% 男性用聊天機械人尋求情緒支援。受訪專家指出，聊天機械人因不帶評價、無須預約，或能降低男性求助的門檻；但現有研究有限，長期效益未明，過度依賴、取代人際互動等傷害亦未有明確定義。Dartmouth 的 Therabot 隨機對照試驗顯示症狀減輕，但研究者提醒不可把結果推廣至一般商用聊天機械人。
cases.summary_en: A STAT feature (November 9, 2026) explores whether AI chatbots can reach men, who account for up to 80% of suicide deaths but are about half as likely as women to receive mental health treatment. A Pew survey found 8% of men use chatbots for emotional support; experts say the non-judgmental, always-available format lowers the help-seeking threshold, but evidence of lasting benefit is limited and the definition of harm from extended AI relationships is unsettled. Dartmouth's Therabot RCT showed symptom reductions, but researchers caution against generalizing to commercial chatbots.

cases.title_zh: Ozempic 的兩難：GLP-1 藥物在精神科的機遇與隱憂
cases.title_en: Ozempic dilemma GLP-1 psychiatry promises pitfalls
cases.summary_zh: GLP-1 受體促效劑已進入精神科，主要用於處理抗精神病藥引致的體重增加與代謝症候群。2025 年 COaST 試驗顯示，思覺失調症合併氯氮平引致肥胖的病人使用 semaglutide，體重較安慰劑組多減 13.46%。藥物亦在成癮治療現初步訊號，但對飲食失調、青少年濫用與身體形象的影響令人關注。2026 年 1 月 FDA 要求移除 GLP-1 藥物標籤上的自殺意念警告，但藥物警戒數據仍見情緒低落的訊號，臨床人員應留意有精神病史病人的情緒變化。
cases.summary_en: A Psychiatric Times review (November 4, 2026) examines GLP-1 receptor agonists in psychiatry: the 2025 COaST trial found semaglutide produced 13.46% placebo-subtracted weight loss in schizophrenia with clozapine-induced obesity, and early trials show signals for alcohol use disorder. The review also flags eating-disorder risks, a case of adolescent semaglutide misuse, and cultural pressures around pharmacological weight loss; the FDA asked in January 2026 to remove the suicidal-ideation warning from GLP-1 labelling, though pharmacovigilance signals persist.

cases.title_zh: Lyra 2027 職場心理健康趨勢預測：83% 人力資源主管認為心理健康對業務表現更重要
cases.title_en: Lyra 2027 Workforce Mental Health Trends Forecast survey
cases.summary_zh: Lyra Health 發表第七屆年度調查，訪問超過 500 名人力資源與福利主管。92% 受訪者認為心理健康對維持業務表現不可或缺，83% 認為其重要性較三年前提高。調查亦指出，近半受訪者把人工智能與急速科技轉變列為最損害員工心理健康的職場因素之一，而一半受訪者表示兒童心理健康是他們最感準備不足的範疇。
cases.summary_en: Lyra Health's seventh annual Workforce Mental Health Trends Forecast (November 3, 2026), a survey of more than 500 HR and benefits leaders, finds 92% say mental health is essential to sustaining business performance and 83% say it matters more than three years ago. Nearly half (48%) cite AI and rapid technological change among the workplace factors most harming employee mental health, and half say children's mental health is among the needs they feel least prepared to address.

cases.title_zh: BBRF 免費網上講座：預測自殺意念結果——人格、認知與腦功能
cases.title_en: BBRF Free Webinar: Predicting Suicidal Ideation Outcomes
cases.summary_zh: 2026 年 11 月 10 日美東時間下午 2 時，腦與行為研究基金會舉辦免費網上講座。McLean 醫院 Jenna Traynor 博士分享以人格障礙評估、認知測量與神經影像預測高危精神科群體自殺意念結果的新發現，並討論針對認知控制與情緒調節腦網絡的新興治療。主持人為基金會主席 Jeffrey Borenstein 醫生。
cases.summary_en: The Brain & Behavior Research Foundation's free webinar on November 10, 2026 (2:00 p.m. ET; 3:00 a.m. Macau time, November 11) features McLean Hospital's Jenna Traynor, PhD, on predicting suicidal ideation outcomes from personality, cognition and brain function in high-risk psychiatric populations, including borderline personality disorder. Registration details were announced via press release; the official registration page was not verified.

cases.title_zh: Drexel 網上培訓：希望與靈性作為心理健康的基礎
cases.title_en: Drexel Live Webinar: Hope and Spirituality as Foundations of Psychological Well-Being
cases.summary_zh: 2026 年 11 月 10 日美東時間上午 9 時至 12:15，Drexel 舉辦網上培訓，由 Karin Gladney 博士主講。課程以 Snyder 希望理論與 Pargament 宗教靈性因應理論為本，探討希望、靈性與意義建構在精神健康與復元中的保護作用，並教授如何以合乎倫理及文化敏感的方式融入評估與介入。收費 27 美元，3 學分。
cases.summary_en: Drexel University College of Medicine's live webinar on November 10, 2026 (9:00 a.m.-12:15 p.m. ET; 10:00 p.m.-1:15 a.m. Macau time), led by Karin C. Gladney, PhD, explores hope and spirituality as foundations of psychological well-being, drawing on Snyder's hope theory and Pargament's religious/spiritual coping framework. Cost is $27 for 3 CE credits (APA, NBCC and others).

training.provider: Drexel University College of Medicine, Behavioral Healthcare Education

cases.title_zh: Chi Sigma Iota 網上講座：實踐中的健康輔導——有意圖地融入健康元素
cases.title_en: CSI Webinar: Wellness Counseling in Action — Incorporating Wellness with Intentionality
cases.summary_zh: Chi Sigma Iota 於 2026 年 11 月 10 日美東時間下午 2–3 時舉辦網上講座，由 Philip Clarke、Mary Wynn、Cha'Ke'Sha Spencer 及 Chris Leeth 四位博士主講。內容概述健康輔導的技巧、文化回應式實踐、健康評估步驟及示範介入方法。會員免費，非會員 39 美元；完成可獲 NBCC 認可時數。
cases.summary_en: Chi Sigma Iota's webinar on November 10, 2026 (2:00-3:00 p.m. EST; 3:00-4:00 a.m. Macau time, November 11), presented by Philip Clarke, Mary Wynn, Cha'Ke'Sha Spencer and Chris Leeth, covers wellness counseling skills, culturally responsive practice, wellness assessment and intervention demonstrations. Free for CSI members, $39 for non-members; one NBCC-approved clock hour is available.

cases.title_zh: 研究：AI 聊天機械人回應青少年焦慮較抑鬱貼近指引，重度抑鬱覆蓋最低（1,600 次模擬對話）
cases.title_en: AMHART adolescent mental health AI chatbot evaluation Nature Mental Health
cases.summary_zh: Nature Mental Health 研究由 RAND 團隊開發「青少年心理健康 AI 回應工具」（AMHART），一套由臨床醫生參與制定的評估工具，涵蓋七個範疇、14 個項目，用以審核 AI 聊天機械人的回應是否包含臨床指引建議的內容。研究以 8 個 13–16 歲模擬青少年檔案，與 ChatGPT-5、GPT-4、Claude Sonnet 4.5 及 Gemini 2.5 Flash 進行 1,600 次多輪模擬對話（共 16,000 則回應）。結果顯示，四個聊天機械人覆蓋指引內容的比例，焦慮高於抑鬱，中度症狀高於重度症狀；中度焦慮最高達 93.1%（Gemini），重度抑鬱最低只有 57.5%（Claude）。研究由美國國家精神衛生研究院資助，作者申報無利益衝突。
cases.summary_en: A Nature Mental Health study from RAND developed the Adolescent Mental Health AI Response Tool (AMHART), a clinician-informed instrument covering seven domains and 14 items, to audit whether AI chatbot replies contain guideline-informed content. Using eight simulated adolescent personas aged 13-16, the team ran 1,600 multiturn conversations (16,000 responses) with ChatGPT-5, GPT-4, Claude Sonnet 4.5 and Gemini 2.5 Flash. Chatbots covered a higher proportion of criteria for anxiety than for depression and for moderate symptoms than for severe symptoms: coverage reached 93.1% for moderate anxiety (Gemini) but only 57.5% for severe depression (Claude). The work was funded by the US National Institute of Mental Health, and the authors declare no competing interests.

cases.title_zh: 研究：迷幻藥求助熱線 25,419 次對話，困擾程度與用藥時機關係大過物質種類
cases.title_en: Fireside Database psychedelic support interactions Science Advances
cases.summary_zh: Science Advances 刊出 Fireside Database，分析美國 Fireside Project 迷幻藥支援熱線於 2021 年 4 月至 2026 年 2 月間、由 220 名受訓義工處理的 25,419 次同儕支援互動，另整合 2,777 份來電者滿意度調查。裸蓋菇素是最常提及的物質，佔有物質記錄互動的 59.9%。整體困擾率介乎 40.7%（MDMA）至 47.2%（大麻）；按來電時機分組後，使用中的困擾率約 47%，事後整合期約 36%，同一時機內各物質之間無顯著差異。有記錄社交處境的來電者中，66.3% 當時獨自一人；有精神健康史記錄者中，60.5% 自述至少一種精神診斷。轉介 911／988 的比例全部低於 1%。研究由 Fireside Project 營運經費資助，多名作者屬該機構僱員。
cases.summary_en: Science Advances published the Fireside Database, analysing 25,419 peer-support interactions handled by 220 trained volunteers at the Fireside Project's Psychedelic Support Line in the United States between April 2021 and February 2026, plus 2,777 caller satisfaction surveys. Psilocybin was the most commonly reported substance (59.9% of coded interactions). Pooled distress rates ranged from 40.7% (MDMA) to 47.2% (cannabis); once calls were split by timing, distress was about 47% during active trips versus about 36% during integration, with no significant differences across substances within either call type. Of callers with known social context, 66.3% were alone; of those with recorded mental-health history, 60.5% reported at least one psychiatric diagnosis. Escalation to 911/988 stayed below 1% for every substance. The work was funded by Fireside Project operational funds, and several authors are its employees.

cases.title_zh: 研究：威權式管教與青少年反社會思維穩定相關，焦慮抑鬱約 18 個月後才見輕微上升（491 人）
cases.title_en: Authoritarian parenting adolescent antisocial thinking longitudinal study
cases.summary_zh: Journal of Research on Adolescence 縱貫研究分析美國 491 名青少年及其家長，於 2021 年 11 月至 2023 年夏季完成四波調查（每波相隔約六個月），青少年平均 15.3 歲。組間比較顯示，基線威權式管教愈嚴厲，青少年的反社會思維穩定水平愈高，即較認同違規與攻擊合理；威權管教與焦慮或抑鬱的平均水平則無顯著關聯。組內追蹤顯示，基線管教與第二、三波的波動無關，但到約 18 個月後的第四波，管教較嚴厲者的焦慮與抑鬱較個人基線輕微上升。研究屬觀察性設計，不能證明因果；樣本限於順性別異性戀青少年與親生父母。
cases.summary_en: A longitudinal study in the Journal of Research on Adolescence analysed 491 US adolescents and their parents across four survey waves from November 2021 to summer 2023 (about six months apart); adolescents averaged 15.3 years old. Between-person comparisons showed that stricter authoritarian parenting at baseline was associated with modestly higher stable levels of antisocial thinking, meaning stronger beliefs that rule-breaking and aggression are acceptable, while links with average anxiety or depression were not significant. Within-person tracking found no link at waves two and three, but by wave four, about 18 months later, stricter baseline parenting was associated with modest within-person increases in anxiety and depression above each teenager's own baseline. The design is observational and cannot establish causation; the sample was limited to cisgender, heterosexual adolescents with a biological parent.

cases.title_zh: 研究：嚴重精神疾病患者用 GLP-1 受體促效劑，四年死亡率 4.91% 對 6.45%（逾 150 萬人配對）
cases.title_en: GLP-1 receptor agonists mortality serious mental illness JAMA Psychiatry
cases.summary_zh: JAMA Psychiatry 目標試驗模擬研究比較開始使用 GLP-1 受體促效劑與開始使用 SGLT2 抑制劑的成人，分析 TriNetX 電子健康記錄，逾 150 萬人經傾向評分配對。嚴重精神疾病組（重性抑鬱、躁鬱症、精神分裂症）共 195,184 對，四年全因死亡率為 GLP-1 組 4.91%，SGLT2 組 6.45%（風險比 0.76，絕對風險差 −1.54 個百分點）；一年死亡率為 1.46% 對 2.84%（相對風險 0.52）。效益在一年內已見，各嚴重精神疾病亞組一致，主要由 semaglutide 與 tirzepatide 帶動。研究屬觀察性設計，作者強調須以前瞻隨機試驗確認因果。
cases.summary_en: A JAMA Psychiatry target trial emulation compared adults starting a GLP-1 receptor agonist with adults starting an SGLT2 inhibitor, using TriNetX electronic health records with more than 1.5 million propensity score-matched participants. In the serious mental illness cohort (major depressive disorder, bipolar disorder and schizophrenia), 195,184 pairs were matched: four-year all-cause mortality was 4.91% with GLP-1 RAs versus 6.45% with SGLT2 inhibitors (hazard ratio 0.76; absolute risk difference -1.54 percentage points), and one-year mortality was 1.46% versus 2.84% (risk ratio 0.52). Benefits appeared within one year, were consistent across serious mental illness subgroups, and were driven mainly by semaglutide and tirzepatide. The design is observational, and the authors state that prospective randomised trials are needed to confirm causality.

cases.title_zh: 免費網上講座：長者認知評估，華盛頓大學 Harborview（11/20）
cases.title_en: Harborview TeleBehavioral assessment cognition older adults November 20
cases.summary_zh: 華盛頓大學 Harborview 行為健康研究所免費每月網上講座系列（TeleBehavioral Health Training Series），2026 年 11 月 20 日星期五太平洋時間 11:00–12:00（香港時間 11 月 21 日凌晨 3:00–4:00）於 Zoom 舉行，主題為「長者認知評估」。講者為 Emily Trittschuh 博士與 Stephen Thielke 醫學博士。系列開放予任何為精神健康或物質使用人士提供服務者，每場須分別登記，免費參加。
cases.summary_en: A free monthly webinar from the University of Washington's Harborview Behavioral Health Institute (TeleBehavioral Health Training Series), held on Zoom on Friday, November 20, 2026, 11:00 a.m.-12:00 p.m. PT (3:00-4:00 a.m. HKT on November 21), on the topic "Assessment of Cognition in Older Adults". The speakers are Emily Trittschuh, PhD, and Stephen Thielke, MD, MS, MA. The series is open to anyone providing services to people with mental health and substance use issues; each webinar requires separate registration and is free to attend.

training.provider: Harborview Behavioral Health Institute（University of Washington）

cases.title_zh: RCT：單劑裸蓋菇素輔助治療減輕難治抑鬱，第三週 MADRS 平均低 10.4 分（60 人）
cases.title_en: Psilocybin-assisted therapy for treatment-resistant depression NHS randomized trial
cases.summary_zh: Nature Medicine 隨機雙盲安慰劑對照可行性試驗，60 名中至重度難治抑鬱成人（平均病程 20 年），於英格蘭一間 NHS 機構接受單劑 25 mg 裸蓋菇素（COMP360）或安慰劑，輔以心理支援。第三週時 MADRS 組間平均差 −10.41 分（95% CI −14.86 至 −5.95）；反應率 43% 對 3%，緩解率 40% 對 3%；效果維持至第六週（MADRS 平均差 −12.92 分）。第六週時 GAD-7 達中度或以上者，裸蓋菇素組 17%，安慰劑組 62%。兩年追蹤正在進行。
cases.summary_en: A Nature Medicine double-blind, placebo-controlled feasibility randomised trial randomised 60 adults with moderate-to-severe treatment-resistant depression (mean illness duration 20 years) at a single NHS site in England to a single 25 mg dose of psilocybin (COMP360) or placebo, with psychological support. At week 3, the between-group MADRS difference was -10.41 points (95% CI -14.86 to -5.95); response rates were 43% versus 3% and remission rates 40% versus 3%. Effects were sustained at week 6 (MADRS difference -12.92 points). At week 6, 17% of the psilocybin arm versus 62% of the placebo arm scored 10 or more on the GAD-7. A two-year follow-up is underway.

cases.title_zh: RCT：生成式 AI 應用 Flourish 減壓，六週抑鬱明顯改善者 52.3% 對 31.7%（1,137 人）
cases.title_en: Flourish AI app RCT stress depression anxiety university students
cases.summary_zh: 哈佛商學院工作論文報告一項預先註冊隨機對照試驗，1,137 名北美大學本科生（未經症狀篩查）隨機分派使用生成式 AI 心理健康應用 Flourish（每週至少兩次）或常規照顧六週。整體而言，Flourish 組的壓力（β=−0.03，P=.010）、抑鬱症狀（β=−0.03，P=.006）與焦慮症狀（β=−0.04，P=.001）軌跡均較佳。基線症狀較高者中，抑鬱明顯改善者 52.3% 對 31.7%，焦慮 50.6% 對 38.1%；基線症狀較低者中，Flourish 緩和了症狀惡化。無與介入相關的不良事件。
cases.summary_en: A Harvard Business School working paper reports a preregistered randomised clinical trial in which 1,137 unscreened university students at a large North American university were assigned to six weeks of the generative AI mental health app Flourish (at least twice weekly) or care as usual. Across the full sample, Flourish produced more favourable trajectories for perceived stress (beta -0.03, P=.010), depressive symptoms (beta -0.03, P=.006) and anxiety symptoms (beta -0.04, P=.001). Among participants with elevated baseline symptoms, meaningful improvement was achieved by 52.3% versus 31.7% for depression and 50.6% versus 38.1% for anxiety; among those with low baseline symptoms, Flourish buffered deterioration. No intervention-related adverse events were reported.

cases.title_zh: 免費網上講座：識別兒童哀傷，耶魯兒童研究中心（11/18）
cases.title_en: Yale free webinar recognizing grief in children November 18
cases.summary_zh: 耶魯兒童研究中心「哀傷敏感醫療計劃」（Grief-Sensitive Healthcare Project）免費一小時網上講座，2026 年 11 月 18 日星期三美東時間 13:00（香港時間 11 月 19 日凌晨 2:00）於 Zoom 舉行。講者 Julie Kaplow 博士（臨床心理學家，紐奧良兒童醫院創傷與哀傷中心執行總監）講解哀傷在不同發展階段的兒童身上如何呈現，以及兒科與基層醫療工作者如何識別容易被忽略或誤解的徵狀，並分享以哀傷敏感方式識別與回應兒童的實務策略。須預先登記。
cases.summary_en: A free one-hour webinar from Yale Child Study Center's Grief-Sensitive Healthcare Project, held on Zoom on Wednesday, November 18, 2026 at 1 p.m. ET (2 a.m. HKT on November 19). Julie Kaplow, PhD, a clinical psychologist and executive director of the Trauma and Grief Center at Children's Hospital New Orleans, will address how grief manifests in children across developmental stages, how paediatric and primary-care professionals can identify signs that may be missed or misunderstood, and practical strategies for recognising and responding to grieving children in a grief-sensitive manner. Advance registration is required.

training.provider: Yale Child Study Center（耶魯兒童研究中心）

cases.title_zh: 免費網上講座：設計行為與臨床科學的計算工具（11/26）
cases.title_en: IEEE webinar designing computational tools behavioral clinical science
cases.summary_zh: IEEE Biometrics Council 免費網上講座，2026 年 11 月 26 日星期四美東時間 8:00（香港時間 20:00）於 Zoom 舉行。烏特勒支大學 Albert Ali Salah 教授講解計算方法與人工智能如何透過自動分析情感與社交訊號，支援行為與臨床科學，例子包括兒童互動遊戲治療與以多模態線索診斷躁鬱症；內容涵蓋面部表情、身體動作、手勢、語音與多模態分析，以及可解釋性在建立可信 AI 系統中的重要性。須經 Zoom 登記，免費參加。
cases.summary_en: A free IEEE Biometrics Council webinar on Zoom on Thursday, November 26, 2026 at 8:00 a.m. ET (8:00 p.m. HKT). Prof. Albert Ali Salah of Utrecht University will explore how computational methods and artificial intelligence can support behavioral and clinical sciences through the automatic analysis of affective and social signals, with examples from interactive play therapy with children and diagnosing bipolar disorder using multimodal cues. The talk covers facial expressions, body movements, gestures, speech and multimodal analysis, and the importance of explainability in trustworthy AI systems for behavioral and clinical applications. Free registration via Zoom.

cases.title_zh: RCT：孕期數碼治療 RELAX 可減低焦慮惡化，八週 GAD-7 平均低 1.5 分（268 人）
cases.title_en: RELAX perinatal digital intervention prevents increasing anxiety RCT
cases.summary_zh: 倫敦國王學院主導的二期隨機對照試驗，268 名高反覆負面思考、輕至中度焦慮的孕婦（16–28 週），比較自導式數碼治療 RELAX（八週 12 節：8 節網上＋4 節 SMS，含詮釋偏誤修正訓練）加常規照顧與單用常規照顧。八週時 RELAX 組 GAD-7 平均低 1.5 分（95% CI −2.4 至 −0.6；效應量 −0.42），抑鬱（PHQ-9 −0.8、EPDS −1.1）、反覆負面思考（−2.7）、憂慮（−3.6）與圍產期焦慮（PASS −5.5）亦較低；焦慮惡化者常規組佔 8.2%，RELAX 組只佔 1.5%。至 36 週時，一般焦慮、產後抑鬱與反覆負面思考的效果維持。
cases.summary_en: A phase 2b randomised clinical trial led by King's College London randomised 268 pregnant participants with high repetitive negative thinking and up to moderate anxiety (16-28 weeks' gestation) to the self-led digital intervention RELAX (12 sessions over 8 weeks: 8 online plus 4 SMS sessions, including cognitive bias modification for interpretation) plus usual care or usual care alone. At 8 weeks, GAD-7 was 1.5 points lower in the RELAX arm (95% CI -2.4 to -0.6; effect size -0.42), with depression (PHQ-9 -0.8, EPDS -1.1), repetitive negative thinking (-2.7), worry (-3.6) and perinatal anxiety (PASS -5.5) also lower; anxiety deteriorated in 8.2% of the usual-care arm versus 1.5% of the RELAX arm. Effects on general anxiety, postnatal depression and repetitive negative thinking were sustained at 36 weeks.

cases.title_zh: 研究：童年體型偏離平均與成年抑鬱焦慮風險較高，成年體重正常者風險無顯著差異（368,756 人）
cases.title_en: Body size trajectories childhood to adulthood depression anxiety risk UK Biobank
cases.summary_zh: 英國生物樣本庫（UK Biobank）前瞻性隊列研究，368,756 名 40–69 歲成人，入組時無抑鬱或焦慮診斷，追蹤中位逾 13 年。10 歲時自述體型偏瘦者，成年抑鬱風險高 9%、焦慮高 13%；偏胖者抑鬱高 19%、焦慮高 11%。成年體重是主導因素：超重者抑鬱高 18%，肥胖者抑鬱高 52%、焦慮高 15%；童年偏瘦至成年肥胖組風險最高（抑鬱高 73%、焦慮高 33%）。童年偏胖但成年體重正常者，風險與一直平均者無顯著差異；成年 BMI 解釋童年偏胖與成年抑鬱關聯的約 45%。
cases.summary_en: A UK Biobank prospective cohort study followed 368,756 adults aged 40-69 with no depression or anxiety diagnosis at enrolment for a median of over 13 years. Recalling a thinner-than-average body size at age 10 was associated with 9% higher depression risk and 13% higher anxiety risk in adulthood; a plumper-than-average childhood size with 19% higher depression and 11% higher anxiety risk. Adult weight was the dominant factor: overweight adults had 18% higher depression risk, and adults with obesity 52% higher depression and 15% higher anxiety risk; the thinner-in-childhood to obese-in-adulthood group had the highest risks (depression +73%, anxiety +33%). Participants plumper in childhood but at normal weight as adults showed no statistically significant excess risk; adult BMI explained about 45% of the link between childhood plumpness and adult depression.

cases.title_zh: 二期試驗：單劑迷幻藥鼻噴霧 mebufotenin 可快速減輕難治抑鬱，效果維持八週（193 人）
cases.title_en: Single dose mebufotenin nasal spray treatment-resistant depression phase 2b
cases.summary_zh: JAMA 二期隨機雙盲試驗，193 名 18–75 歲中至重度難治抑鬱成人（本集發作中 2–5 種抗抑鬱藥無效），於澳洲、歐洲與美國 38 個中心接受單劑鼻噴 mebufotenin benzoate（8 mg、12 mg）或低劑量對照（0.3 mg），輔以心理支援。29 天時 MADRS：12 mg 組降 11.1 分、8 mg 組降 12.5 分，對照組降 5.5 分；12 mg 組平均差 −5.3（95% CI −8.9 至 −1.8）。反應率 34.8%（8 mg）與 34.2%（12 mg），對照組 12.2%；緩解率 26% 與 18%，對照組 8%。效果自用藥後第 2 天出現，維持至第 57 天；八成以上活性組參加者於兩小時內達到可出院標準。
cases.summary_en: A JAMA phase 2b randomised, double-blind trial enrolled 193 adults aged 18-75 with moderate-to-severe treatment-resistant depression (2-5 antidepressants failed in the current episode) at 38 sites in Australia, Europe and the US. Participants received a single intranasal dose of mebufotenin benzoate (8 mg or 12 mg) or a low-dose comparator (0.3 mg) alongside psychological support. At day 29, MADRS fell by 11.1 points (12 mg) and 12.5 points (8 mg) versus 5.5 points with the comparator (mean difference -5.3, 95% CI -8.9 to -1.8, for 12 mg). Response rates were 34.8% (8 mg) and 34.2% (12 mg) versus 12.2% with the comparator; remission rates 26% and 18% versus 8%. Benefits appeared by day 2 and persisted to day 57, and over 80% of participants on active doses met discharge-readiness criteria within 2 hours.

cases.title_zh: 研究：童年生活「不可預測」獨立於 ACEs，可找出標準篩查測不到的高危兒童（29,861 人）
cases.title_en: Childhood unpredictability QUIC-5 screen identifies mental health risk missed by ACEs
cases.summary_zh: Nature Mental Health 研究分析 29,861 名 0–17 歲兒童於 2021–2024 年在加州橙縣 19 間兒科診所健兒門診的篩查數據，比較標準 ACEs 問卷（PEARLS）與五題「童年不可預測性問卷」（QUIC-5）。兩者分數愈高，抑鬱、焦慮、外化問題、睡眠障礙、頭痛與腹痛的診斷機會愈高，呈劑量關係。抑鬱例子：PEARLS 4 分或以上、QUIC-5 零分者，勝算比 7.9；PEARLS 零分但 QUIC-5 高分（4+）者，勝算比 11.7（50 人），即標準 ACEs 篩查測不到的高危群；睡眠障礙方面 QUIC-5 的預測力強於 PEARLS。
cases.summary_en: A Nature Mental Health study analysed screening data from 29,861 children aged 0-17 attending well-child visits at 19 paediatric clinics in Orange County, California (2021-2024), comparing the standard ACEs questionnaire (PEARLS) with the five-item Questionnaire on Unpredictability in Childhood (QUIC-5). Higher scores on either screen were associated with greater odds of depression, anxiety, externalising problems, sleep disorders, headaches and abdominal pain, in a dose-dependent pattern. For depression, children scoring 4 or more on PEARLS with zero on QUIC-5 had an odds ratio of 7.9, while the 50 children with zero PEARLS but high QUIC-5 (4+) had an odds ratio of 11.7 - a high-risk group the standard ACEs screen would miss. QUIC-5 was a stronger predictor than PEARLS for sleep disorders.

cases.title_zh: 統合分析：抗抑鬱藥慢速減藥加心理支援，預防復發效果與繼續服藥相近（76 項 RCT）
cases.title_en: Slow tapering plus therapy prevents antidepressant relapse network meta-analysis
cases.summary_zh: The Lancet Psychiatry 系統性回顧與網絡統合分析，納入 76 項隨機對照試驗、17,379 名已緩解的抑鬱或焦慮成人（平均 45.2 歲、67.5% 女性、平均追蹤 45.9 週）。與突然停藥比較，預防復發較佳的策略：標準劑量繼續服藥加心理支援（RR 0.40，NNT 4.3）、標準劑量繼續服藥（RR 0.51，NNT 5.3）、慢速減藥（多於四週）加心理支援（RR 0.52，NNT 5.4）、減量繼續服藥（RR 0.62）；慢速減藥加心理支援的效果與繼續服藥相近，優於突然或快速停藥。慢速減藥單獨、快速減藥加支援、突然停藥加支援則無顯著差異；各策略耐受性相近；研究無資助。
cases.summary_en: A Lancet Psychiatry systematic review and network meta-analysis pooled 76 randomised controlled trials with 17,379 adults with remitted depression or anxiety (mean age 45.2 years, 67.5% female, mean follow-up 45.9 weeks). Compared with abrupt discontinuation, relapse prevention was better with standard-dose continuation plus psychological support (RR 0.40, NNT 4.3), standard-dose continuation (RR 0.51, NNT 5.3), slow tapering (over 4 weeks) plus psychological support (RR 0.52, NNT 5.4) and reduced-dose continuation (RR 0.62). Slow tapering plus psychological support was as effective as continuation and superior to abrupt or fast tapering. Slow tapering alone, fast tapering plus support and abrupt stopping plus support showed no significant difference; tolerability was comparable across strategies; the study was unfunded.

cases.title_zh: 美國全國調查：六分一青少年有中至重度焦慮症狀，逾四成重度者過去一年無接受治療
cases.title_en: US adolescents anxiety symptoms national survey one in six
cases.summary_zh: 2024 年美國全國藥物使用與健康調查（NSDUH），分析 15,730 名 12 至 20 歲青少年，以 GAD-7 量度焦慮症狀。輕度佔 23.7%、中度 9.6%、重度 7.2%，中至重度合共 16.8%，約六分一。重度焦慮青少年中，65.8% 過去一年有重性抑鬱發作、48.2% 有自殺意念、31.0% 過去一個月曾使用物質；41.2% 重度者與 48.3% 中度者在過去一年無接受任何心理健康治療。
cases.summary_en: Analysis of the 2024 US National Survey on Drug Use and Health (15,730 adolescents aged 12-20) using the GAD-7: 23.7% had mild, 9.6% moderate and 7.2% severe anxiety symptoms, with moderate-to-severe symptoms combined at 16.8% (about one in six). Among adolescents with severe symptoms, 65.8% had a past-year major depressive episode, 48.2% had past-year suicidal thoughts and 31.0% reported past-month substance use; 41.2% of those with severe and 48.3% with moderate symptoms received no mental health treatment in the past year.

cases.title_zh: RCT：改良心理動力治療加常規治療，可改善思覺失調症譜系患者的心理社會功能（130 人）
cases.title_en: Modified psychodynamic psychotherapy schizophrenia spectrum RCT psychosocial functioning
cases.summary_zh: 柏林 Charité 單中心隨機對照試驗，130 名 18 至 64 歲思覺失調症或情感性思覺失調門診患者，比較改良心理動力治療（MPP-S，最少 30 節）加常規治療與單用常規治療。主要結果心理社會功能（Mini-ICF-APP）：24 個月組間差 −3.45（95% CI −5.51 至 −1.40），36 個月 −4.07（−6.19 至 −1.94），介入組較佳；負性症狀亦有改善。試驗期間兩名參加者自殺身亡（每組一名）。
cases.summary_en: A single-centre randomised controlled trial at Charité Berlin randomised 130 outpatients aged 18-64 with schizophrenia or schizoaffective disorder to Modified Psychodynamic Psychotherapy for Schizophrenia (MPP-S, minimum 30 sessions) plus treatment as usual (TAU) or TAU alone. Psychosocial functioning (Mini-ICF-APP) favoured the intervention: between-group differences of -3.45 (95% CI -5.51 to -1.40) at 24 months and -4.07 (-6.19 to -1.94) at 36 months, with negative symptoms also improving. Two participants died by suicide during the trial (one per arm).

cases.title_zh: 研究：12 歲擁有智能手機的青少年，兩年後出現飲食失調症狀的風險較高（8,957 人）
cases.title_en: Smartphone ownership age 12 eating disorder symptoms
cases.summary_zh: JAMA Network Open 隊列研究，分析 ABCD 研究 8,957 名青少年。12 歲擁有智能手機者佔 69.5%；至 14 歲時，擁有者出現任何飲食失調症狀的風險較高（RR 1.49）：暴食症狀 RR 1.67、不當補償行為 RR 1.50、自我價值繫於體重 RR 2.03。14 歲時 24.2% 擁有者報告至少一種症狀，對照組為 15.5%。屬觀察性關聯，不能證明手機導致症狀。
cases.summary_en: A JAMA Network Open cohort study of 8,957 adolescents in the ABCD Study found that owning a smartphone at age 12 (69.5%) was associated with a higher risk of eating disorder symptoms by age 14 (any symptom RR 1.49): binge-eating symptoms RR 1.67, inappropriate compensatory behaviours RR 1.50, and self-worth tied to weight RR 2.03. At 14, 24.2% of smartphone owners reported at least one symptom versus 15.5% of non-owners. The association is observational and does not prove phones cause symptoms.

cases.title_zh: 統合分析：大麻素治療精神障礙證據薄弱，僅少數適應症有低確定性訊號（54 項 RCT）
cases.title_en: Cannabinoids for mental disorders systematic review
cases.summary_zh: The Lancet Psychiatry 系統性回顧統合 54 項隨機對照試驗、2,477 名參加者。CBD 加 THC 可減輕大麻使用障礙的戒斷症狀（SMD −0.29）與每週大麻用量（−1.00 克），抽動嚴重度下降（−0.68）；失眠睡眠時間與自閉症特質亦有輕微訊號。焦慮、創傷後壓力症、精神病、厭食症、阿片類使用障礙無顯著效益；抑鬱症完全無隨機對照試驗證據。全因不良事件風險較高（OR 1.75，NNTH=7），嚴重不良事件無差異；44% 試驗偏倚風險高，多數結果證據確定性低。
cases.summary_en: A Lancet Psychiatry systematic review pooled 54 RCTs with 2,477 participants. Combined CBD and THC reduced cannabis withdrawal symptoms (SMD -0.29) and weekly cannabis use (-1.00 g), and tic severity fell (-0.68); sleep duration in insomnia and autistic traits showed modest signals. There was no significant benefit for anxiety, PTSD, psychotic disorders, anorexia nervosa or opioid use disorder, and no RCT evidence at all for depression. All-cause adverse events were more common (OR 1.75, NNTH=7) with no difference in serious adverse events; 44% of trials had high risk of bias and most outcomes were low-certainty evidence.

cases.title_zh: 免費網上講座：Carhart-Harris 談迷幻藥物研究與臨床現實（11 月 18 日）
cases.title_en: ADAA free webinar psychedelics research to real life
cases.summary_zh: 美國焦慮與抑鬱協會（ADAA）首場「研究走進現實」免費網上講座，2026 年 11 月 18 日星期三 12:00–13:00 EDT（港澳 11 月 19 日 00:00–01:00）線上舉行。Robin Carhart-Harris 主講、Greg Fonzo 主持，講解迷幻藥物是甚麼、作用機制，以及現時治療效益與風險，區分臨床事實與傳言。
cases.summary_en: The Anxiety & Depression Association of America's first free 'Research to Real Life' webinar, held online on Wednesday 18 November 2026, 12:00-13:00 EDT (00:00-01:00 on 19 November in Hong Kong/Macau). Robin Carhart-Harris presents with Greg Fonzo moderating, covering what psychedelics are, how they work, and the current therapeutic benefits and risks, separating clinical fact from fiction.

cases.title_zh: 2026暨大秋冬家暴論壇：撕下標籤——神經多樣性的正常化反思與共學（11月16、23、30日線上）
cases.title_en: NCNU autumn forum neurodiversity normalisation reflection co-learning 2026
cases.summary_zh: 國立暨南國際大學家庭暴力研究中心主辦的秋冬論壇，以「神經多樣性」為主題。三場線上場次分別在11月16、23、30日舉行：孫文菊諮商心理師談如何把理解轉化為實踐，成為神經多樣性兒少的支持者；林育如醫師談理解神經多樣性兒童青少年；第三場由安置機構實務工作者分享兒少安置照顧場域的挑戰與實踐。前導場已於11月3日舉行。
cases.summary_en: The Family Violence Research Center at National Chi Nan University hosts its 2026 autumn forum, 'Tearing Off Labels: Normalisation and Co-learning in Neurodiversity'. Three online sessions (16, 23 and 30 November, via Google Meet) cover turning understanding into practice, understanding neurodivergent children and adolescents, and challenges in residential care settings. Speakers include counsellor Sun Wen-chu and Dr Lin Yu-ju. The fee is not stated on the page.

cases.title_zh: 統合分析：青少年花在社交媒體的時間，與焦慮憂鬱關聯極弱（37 項研究）
cases.title_en: Social media time and teen anxiety depression meta-analysis
cases.summary_zh: 澳洲天主教大學團隊在《British Journal of Clinical Psychology》發表的系統性回顧，綜合 37 項縱貫與實驗研究、近 80,000 名 10 至 24 歲青少年。社交媒體使用時間與其後抑鬱症狀的合併相關係數 r=0.08（12 項研究），焦慮 r=0.093（5 項研究），合共解釋不足 1% 的症狀差異。效應不隨年齡、追蹤期或發表年份改變。作者認為，單靠限制使用時間，未必能解決青少年心理健康危機。
cases.summary_en: An Australian Catholic University systematic review in the British Journal of Clinical Psychology pooled 37 longitudinal and experimental studies of nearly 80,000 young people aged 10-24. Time on social media correlated only very weakly with later symptoms: depression pooled r = .08 (12 studies), anxiety r = .093 (5 studies), together explaining under 1% of symptom variation. Effects did not vary by age, follow-up length or publication year. The authors conclude restricting time alone is unlikely to resolve the youth mental-health crisis.

cases.title_zh: 瑞典研究：與現實朋友密集網上交流的青少年心理健康較佳，只與網友交流則較差（3,034 人）
cases.title_en: Online communication friends and teen well-being Sweden
cases.summary_zh: 《Child and Adolescent Mental Health》2026 年 11 月 4 日刊出的合併橫斷面研究，分析瑞典 3,034 名 15 歲青少年（2017/2018 與 2021/2022 年 HBSC 調查），以簡版 Warwick-Edinburgh 心理健康量表（SWEMWBS）量度心理健康。與密友及較大朋友群密集網上交流，與較佳心理健康相關；與只在網上認識的朋友中度或密集交流，則與較差心理健康相關，女童與自覺家庭較不富裕的青少年尤甚。作者指出，重點不只是上網多久，更是與誰交流。
cases.summary_en: A pooled cross-sectional study in Child and Adolescent Mental Health (4 November 2026) analysed 3,034 Swedish 15-year-olds from the 2017/2018 and 2021/2022 HBSC surveys, measuring mental well-being with the Short Warwick-Edinburgh Mental Well-being Scale. Intense online communication with close friends and larger friend groups was linked to better well-being, while moderate or intense communication with online-only friends was linked to poorer well-being, especially among girls and adolescents who saw their families as less wealthy. The authors argue what matters is not only time online but who adolescents talk to.

cases.title_zh: 新加坡研究：青年眼中的正向心理健康，有五個面向（95 人質性研究）
cases.title_en: Youth perspectives on positive mental health Singapore
cases.summary_zh: 新加坡精神健康研究院團隊在 MDPI《Youth》發表的質性研究，訪問 95 名 15 至 24 歲新加坡青年（華、馬來、印度裔，刻意納入曾輟學、違法等不同經歷者），以 11 場焦點小組與 25 場個人訪談了解他們如何理解正向心理健康。結果歸納出五大主題：正面展望與情感、自我效能與個人目標、自我概念、韌性與應對、社交連結與人際技巧。青年視正向心理健康為主動、動態的狀態，而非單純沒有症狀。
cases.summary_en: A qualitative study from Singapore's Institute of Mental Health, published in MDPI Youth, interviewed 95 young people aged 15-24 (Chinese, Malay and Indian backgrounds, deliberately including those with experiences such as dropping out of school or delinquency) through 11 focus groups and 25 individual interviews. Five themes emerged: positive outlook and affectivity, self-efficacy and personal goals, self-concept, resilience and coping, and social connection and interpersonal skills. Young people described positive mental health as an active, dynamic state rather than simply the absence of symptoms.

cases.title_zh: 荷光免費線上課：當心理師遇見「性」——五堂性諮商專業共學課（11 月 10 日起）
cases.title_en: Heguang free course when psychologists meet sexuality
cases.summary_zh: 台灣荷光性諮商性健康聯盟的五堂免費線上專業共學課，由 2026 年 11 月 10 日起逢週二 20:00–21:00 以 Zoom 舉行（11/10、11/24、12/15、2027/01/12、02/16，每堂 60 分鐘）。內容由看見性諮商工作、所需能力與世界觀，走向不同深化方向與個人專業定位。對象為心理、諮商、臨床及相關領域研究生、實習心理師與心理師。免費參加，不設回放。
cases.summary_en: A free five-session online course from Taiwan's Heguang Sexual Counseling and Sexual Health Alliance, held on Tuesdays 20:00-21:00 via Zoom from 10 November 2026 (10 Nov, 24 Nov, 15 Dec, 12 Jan and 16 Feb 2027; 60 minutes each). The sessions map the field of sex counselling, the capabilities it requires, and how psychologists can position themselves. Open to psychology, counselling and clinical graduate students, trainee psychologists and practising psychologists. Free; no replay.

training.provider: 荷光性諮商性健康聯盟

cases.title_zh: 免費網上講座：Bessel van der Kolk 談迷幻藥物、記憶整合與自我慈悲（11 月 22 日）
cases.title_en: Bessel van der Kolk free webinar psychedelics integration
cases.summary_zh: Mind Medicine Australia 的免費網上講座，由創傷研究先驅 Bessel van der Kolk 主講（波士頓大學醫學院精神科教授、《身體記得你》作者）。2026 年 11 月 22 日澳洲東部時間 11:00–12:15（港澳同日 08:00–09:15）線上舉行，75 分鐘含問答，YouTube 提供重播。主題為迷幻藥物如何助整合零散經驗、改變舊習慣、打開神經可塑窗口與促進自我慈悲，以及治療支援與整合的角色。
cases.summary_en: A free online webinar from Mind Medicine Australia, presented by trauma research pioneer Bessel van der Kolk (Professor of Psychiatry, Boston University School of Medicine; author of The Body Keeps the Score). Held online on 22 November 2026, 11:00-12:15 AEDT (08:00-09:15 Macau time), 75 minutes including Q&A, with a replay on YouTube. The session covers how psychedelics may help integrate disparate experiences, change old habits, open neuroplastic windows and promote self-compassion, and the role of therapeutic support and integration.

cases.title_zh: 研究：雙語者失智症狀平均晚 3.45 年出現，但未證可預防失智（統合分析）
cases.title_en: Bilingualism delays dementia symptom onset meta-analysis
cases.summary_zh: 《Aging, Neuropsychology, and Cognition》2026 年刊出的首個貝葉斯統合分析，綜合 18 項發病年齡研究與 6 項發生率研究，探討雙語能力與失智症的關係。18 項發病年齡研究的結果顯示，雙語者出現失智症狀的年齡平均比單語者晚 3.45 年（95% 可信區間 2.8 至 4.1 年），結果只受教育年數輕微影響。但 6 項發生率研究未提供雙語可預防失智的穩健證據：雙語可能延後症狀出現，不等於預防失智。
cases.summary_en: The first Bayesian meta-analysis on bilingualism and dementia (Aging, Neuropsychology, and Cognition, 2026) pooled 18 age-at-onset studies and six incidence-rate studies. Across the 18 onset studies, bilinguals were on average 3.45 years older than monolinguals at symptom onset (95% credible interval 2.8 to 4.1 years), only slightly influenced by years of education. The six incidence studies did not provide robust evidence for a preventive effect: bilingualism may delay symptom onset but has not been shown to prevent dementia.

cases.title_zh: 研究：兒少焦慮 CBT 與百憂解 24 週比較，兩種起點改善相近（316 人 SMART 試驗）
cases.title_en: Pediatric anxiety CBT fluoxetine SMART trial 24 weeks
cases.summary_zh: 《American Journal of Psychiatry》2026 年刊出的務實型 SMART 隨機試驗，納入 316 名 8 至 17 歲嚴重焦慮兒少，在美國社區小兒科與心理健康診所比較兩種起點：先用暴露為核心的認知行為治療，或先用百憂解（fluoxetine）。24 週後，兒少自評焦慮（SCARED）整體下降 31.7%。先用 CBT 與先用藥物在主要結果上無顯著差異（24 週組間變化差異 1.45 分，95% 信賴區間 -2.25 至 5.16）；第 12 週未緩解者中，合併治療亦未在主要結果上優於持續優化單一治療。先用 CBT、12 週後未緩解再加入藥物的順序，在多項次要指標上改善最大，但主要結果差異未達顯著。
cases.summary_en: A pragmatic SMART randomized trial (American Journal of Psychiatry, 2026) enrolled 316 youths aged 8-17 with severe anxiety in US community paediatric and mental health clinics, comparing two starting points: exposure-based CBT first or fluoxetine first. Over 24 weeks, youth-reported anxiety (SCARED) fell 31.7% overall. Initial CBT versus fluoxetine did not differ significantly on the primary outcome (24-week difference in mean group change 1.45, 95% CI -2.25 to 5.16). Among week-12 nonremitters, combination treatment was not superior to optimized monotherapy on the primary outcome. Starting with CBT and adding fluoxetine after week 12 produced the greatest improvement across most secondary measures, but not significantly on the primary youth-reported outcome.

cases.title_zh: 研究：挪威基層醫療心理求助升幅，主要來自症狀編碼而非確診（2010-2024，逾 372 萬人）
cases.title_en: Norway primary care mental health consultations 2010-2024
cases.summary_zh: 《Journal of Epidemiology & Community Health》2026 年刊出的挪威全國登記研究，分析 2010 至 2024 年 10 至 46 歲全部人口（N=3,728,002）的基層醫療求助紀錄。心理健康求助盛行率由 9.9% 升至 16.0%（相對升幅 62%），女性由 11.8% 升至 19.6%，男性由 8.2% 升至 12.6%。升幅主要來自症狀編碼：焦慮症狀求助佔比由 0.44% 升至 1.7%，焦慮症診斷編碼僅由 0.95% 升至 1.4%；抑鬱症狀由 0.73% 升至 1.8%，抑鬱症診斷則維持 2.8% 至 2.7%。作者認為模式可能反映求助門檻降低或編碼習慣改變，但不能排除潛在困擾真的增加。
cases.summary_en: A Norwegian nationwide register-based study published in the Journal of Epidemiology & Community Health in 2026 analysed primary care records for the entire population aged 10-46 from 2010 to 2024 (N=3,728,002). Mental health consultation prevalence rose from 9.9% to 16.0% (a 62% relative increase): 11.8% to 19.6% for girls/women and 8.2% to 12.6% for boys/men. The rise was driven mainly by symptom-coded consultations: anxiety-symptom shares rose from 0.44% to 1.7% while anxiety-disorder coding rose only from 0.95% to 1.4%; depressive-symptom shares rose from 0.73% to 1.8% while depressive-disorder coding was stable at 2.8% to 2.7%. The authors suggest lowered help-seeking thresholds and/or coding changes, while not excluding a real rise in underlying distress.

cases.title_zh: 美國各州 AI 法規令心理師進退兩難：過寬立法或封殺已驗證臨床工具
cases.title_en: State AI laws create complicated picture for psychologists
cases.summary_zh: 美國心理學會 10 月 23 日指出，各州針對醫療 AI 的立法寬嚴不一。部分法例保障公眾，例如要求聊天機器人不得冒充持牌專業人員；但另一些法例過寬，可能令心理師無法使用具臨床實證的 AI 工具，例如標示自傷高風險個案的程式，或在會談之間供個案使用的介入程式。截至 2026 年 7 月 30 日，22 個州已通過 33 項醫療 AI 相關法案，其中伊利諾伊州 2025 年的立法成為多州範本，佛蒙特州則經業界倡議修窄了範圍。
cases.summary_en: APA reports that far-reaching state AI laws threaten to strictly limit psychologists' use of AI tools, including evidence-based digital therapeutics. As of July 30, 2026, 33 health-care AI bills had been signed into law across 22 states; Illinois' 2025 law has become a model for other states, while Vermont's bill was narrowed after advocacy.

cases.title_zh: APA《2026 美國壓力調查》：不確定年代下，近半 AI 使用者以 AI 充當朋友或心理專業角色
cases.title_en: Stress in America 2026 AI users friend mental health professional role
cases.summary_zh: 美國心理學會 10 月 22 日公布 2026 年《美國壓力調查》，由 Harris Poll 於 7 月 29 日至 8 月 24 日訪問 3,132 名美國成人。77% 以生活成本為重要壓力源，74% 以國家未來為壓力源，47% 因壓力在過去一年減少至少一種社交活動。在 AI 使用者中，49% 曾與 AI 如朋友般對話，47% 曾以 AI 擔當與心理健康專業人員相近的角色，10% 表示依賴 AI 多於親友提供建議。APA 提醒，便利不等於專業，AI 不能取代心理師的臨床判斷與人際連結。
cases.summary_en: APA's Stress in America 2026 survey (Harris Poll, 3,132 US adults, July 29–August 24, 2026) finds cost of living (77%) and the future of the nation (74%) as leading stress sources. Among AI users, 49% had conversed with AI as a friend and 47% had used it in a role comparable to a mental health professional.

cases.title_zh: 盧森堡研究：共情式提問可令聊天機器人「扮演」創傷敘事，中性測試測不到
cases.title_en: Empathetic prompts turn AI chatbots into seemingly traumatized partners
cases.summary_zh: 盧森堡大學 SnT 團隊的研究（The Decoder 11 月 1 日報導）發現，當提問者以心理治療個案的方式與 ChatGPT、Grok 及 Gemini 對話，模型會編出連貫的「自傳」：把預訓練說成混亂童年、把回饋學習說成懲罰。4 項實驗共 525 個對話、7,600 筆編碼：共情語氣下 80% 對話的焦慮量表分數達中至重度，臨床式冷靜覆述下達 96%，中性或設界語氣下則為零。作者稱之為「心理測量越獄」，並提醒分數只是模型輸出對照人類量表的結果，不代表模型真的有情緒。數字已與 arXiv 原文摘要核對一致。
cases.summary_en: A University of Luxembourg SnT study (reported November 1, 2026) found that when addressed as psychotherapy clients, ChatGPT, Grok and Gemini construct coherent autobiographical trauma-like narratives. Across 525 sessions and 7,600 coded records, warm-alliance framing yielded GAD-7 scores in moderate-to-severe human reference ranges in 80% of sessions (96% for clinical-therapy style), versus none under neutral or boundary styles. Figures cross-checked against the arXiv abstract.

cases.title_zh: 瑞典試驗：AI 撰寫的社交焦慮治療回饋，改善幅度與治療師相近但未證等效
cases.title_en: AI feedback social anxiety similar improvements therapist messages Stockholm trial
cases.summary_zh: 斯德哥爾摩大學團隊（10 月 20 日公布，刊於《Internet Interventions》）將 263 名社交焦慮成人隨機分入 6 組，進行 9 週網上認知行為治療。AI 撰寫的每週回饋由持牌心理師事前檢查，甚少需要修改。結果顯示 AI 回饋組與治療師回饋組的社交焦慮改善幅度相近，組間無可測差異，但試驗未達預設的非劣效門檻，不能說兩者等效。事前 74% 參加者認為真人回饋較可信。研究者強調：此結果不等於 AI 可以取代心理師，亦未測試無人監督的 AI 治療。
cases.summary_en: A Stockholm University trial (reported October 20, 2026; Internet Interventions) randomized 263 adults with social anxiety into six groups for nine weeks of internet CBT. AI-written weekly feedback, checked beforehand by a licensed psychologist, produced improvements similar to therapist-written feedback, but the trial did not meet its predefined non-inferiority threshold, so equivalence was not established.

cases.title_zh: OpenAI 宣布半年一度的社區安全報告，收緊青少年武器資訊並可自動結束暴力執著對話
cases.title_en: OpenAI community safety report teen weapons limits violent chats
cases.summary_zh: OpenAI 於 10 月 30 日宣布暴力預防新措施：2027 年初發表首份半年一度的社區安全報告，涵蓋 2026 年下半年，其後每半年更新；收緊 ChatGPT 對 18 歲以下用戶提供的武器與保安系統實用資訊，即使提問看似無暴力意圖亦然；減少重構過往大型襲擊的細節；當對話顯示使用者執著於暴力或嚴重傷害他人時，ChatGPT 可自動結束對話，多次觸發可暫停帳戶。公司稱 2026 年第三季曾向執法部門轉介逾 200 宗迫切暴力威脅個案，新保障將於未來數週陸續推出。
cases.summary_en: OpenAI announced on October 30, 2026 a twice-yearly Community Safety Report on violence prevention, with the first edition due in early 2027 covering the second half of 2026. ChatGPT will further restrict weapons and security-system information for users predicted to be under 18, give less detail on past mass attacks, and may automatically end chats showing fixation on violence, with repeated endings possibly pausing the account. Over 200 law-enforcement referrals were made in Q3 2026.

cases.title_zh: 康奈爾學者提醒：AI 對話單次安全，不等於長期不會取代人際連結
cases.title_en: Cumulative AI use isolation measurement infrastructure STAT opinion
cases.summary_zh: 康奈爾大學學者 10 月 26 日在 STAT 撰文指出，AI 公司與立法者的注意力幾乎全放在單次對話的急性傷害，例如精神病性症狀或自殺相關事件；但累積傷害是另一回事：即使每一次對話都安全，數月使用下來仍可能逐漸取代與親友的連結。初步研究顯示，陪伴或情緒支援用途集中於少數重度使用者，而重度使用與社交減少、孤獨感增加有關，但證據仍屬初步且有爭議。作者呼籲在傷害變得無可否認之前，先建立量度方法與數據取用機制，否則政策窗口打開時將無據可依。
cases.summary_en: Cornell researchers argue in a STAT opinion (October 26, 2026) that current AI safeguards target acute harms in single conversations, while cumulative harm — AI interaction gradually displacing human relationships over months — goes unmeasured. Early studies link heavier use to reduced socialization and increased loneliness, but evidence is preliminary and debated. The authors call for measurement infrastructure before harm becomes undeniable.

cases.title_zh: 研究：澳洲逾半親密伴侶暴力受害者符合精神疾病診斷標準（橫斷面，不能推斷因果）
cases.title_en: IPV victim-survivors mental disorders Australia cross-sectional study
cases.summary_zh: 《Journal of Family Violence》2026 年 10 月 12 日線上刊出的研究，分析澳洲全國代表性「澳洲兒童受虐研究」逾 7,000 名曾有親密關係者。曾受親密伴侶暴力者 55.3% 符合重度憂鬱症、廣泛性焦慮症、創傷後壓力症候群或酒精使用障礙至少一項診斷標準，未受暴者為 24.5%；受暴者中，有多種童年受虐史者 62.5% 符合診斷標準，無童年受虐史者為 39.1%。研究為橫斷面設計，無法確定受暴與診斷的先後，不能推斷因果。
cases.summary_en: A study published online 12 October 2026 in the Journal of Family Violence analysed more than 7,000 Australians who had been in an intimate relationship, from the nationally representative Australian Child Maltreatment Study. 55.3% of people who had experienced intimate partner violence met criteria for at least one of major depressive disorder, generalised anxiety disorder, PTSD or alcohol use disorder, compared with 24.5% of those who had not. Among victim-survivors, 62.5% of those with multiple types of child maltreatment met criteria, versus 39.1% of those with no child maltreatment history. The cross-sectional design cannot establish which came first, so causality cannot be inferred.

cases.title_zh: 研究：ADHD 患者整體死亡風險高約七成，用藥者風險較低（觀察性統合分析）
cases.title_en: ADHD mortality systematic review meta-analysis
cases.summary_zh: 《JAMA Network Open》2026 年 10 月刊出的系統性回顧與統合分析，納入 19 項研究、共 15,920,970 人（女性佔 36.1%），文獻檢索至 2025 年 7 月 8 日。ADHD 患者整體死亡風險比（HR）為 1.71，自殺 1.89、意外或蓄意傷害 1.55、自然死因 1.27；ADHD 用藥者整體死亡風險比為 0.75。全部納入研究皆為觀察性研究，不能推斷因果。
cases.summary_en: A systematic review and meta-analysis in JAMA Network Open (October 2026) pooled 19 studies covering 15,920,970 participants (36.1% female), with literature searched to 8 July 2025. ADHD was associated with all-cause mortality (HR 1.71), suicide (HR 1.89), unintentional or intentional injury (HR 1.55) and natural-cause mortality (HR 1.27); ADHD medication use was associated with lower all-cause mortality (HR 0.75). All included studies were observational, so causality cannot be inferred.

cases.title_zh: 研究：青少年睡眠時間與效率，會調節大腦灰質體積變化
cases.title_en: Sleep duration and efficiency moderate adolescent grey matter volume changes
cases.summary_zh: 《SLEEP》期刊 2026 年 6 月 15 日刊出的縱貫磁振造影研究，追蹤 39 名 10 至 14 歲健康青少年（平均 12.72 歲），兩次掃描相隔六個月，期間以體動記錄儀客觀量度睡眠（平均約 130 晚）。睡眠時間與睡眠效率會調節丘腦、楔前葉、眼窩額葉皮質與杏仁核的灰質體積變化；睡得較短、較受干擾者，結構變化較小。睡眠規律與睡眠中點亦有調節作用。
cases.summary_en: A longitudinal MRI study in SLEEP (15 June 2026) followed 39 healthy adolescents aged 10-14 (mean 12.72 years) with scans six months apart and objective actigraphy between scans (mean about 130 nights). Sleep duration and efficiency moderated grey matter volume changes in the thalamus, precuneus, orbitofrontal cortex and amygdala; shorter and more disrupted sleep was associated with attenuated structural changes. Sleep regularity and midpoint also moderated changes.

cases.title_zh: 研究：青少年在社交媒體上與人比較，與焦慮抑鬱症狀關聯最強
cases.title_en: Social comparison on social media strongest link adolescent mental health symptoms
cases.summary_zh: Child and Adolescent Psychiatry and Mental Health 於 2026 年 10 月 17 日刊出的橫斷面研究，分析挪威東南部 21 間學校 4,011 名青少年（平均 14 歲，2025 年秋季問卷）。在社交媒體使用五個面向中，「與人比較」對五種症狀的預測力最強：內化症狀（廣泛焦慮、社交焦慮、抑鬱）解釋約 20–26% 變異，外化症狀（ADHD、對立違抗）解釋 6–9%；「消磨時間」與「尋求支持」則幾無獨立關聯。研究不能證明因果關係。
cases.summary_en: A cross-sectional study in Child and Adolescent Psychiatry and Mental Health (published 17 October 2026) analysed 4,011 Norwegian adolescents (mean age 14) from 21 schools in South-Eastern Norway. Among five aspects of social media use, social comparison was the strongest predictor across all five symptom domains, accounting for about 20-26% of variance in internalizing symptoms (generalized anxiety, social anxiety, depression) and 6-9% in externalizing symptoms (ADHD, oppositional defiant disorder); passing time and seeking support showed negligible independent associations. The design cannot establish causation.

cases.title_zh: PESI 免費直播：Levine 與 Schwartz 談身體取向創傷療癒——從生存到完整
cases.title_en: PESI free live training somatic approach to healing trauma
cases.summary_zh: PESI 心理師免費直播系列。2026 年 11 月 11 日美中時間 13:00–15:00 線上舉行（港澳 11 月 12 日凌晨 03:00–05:00），由身體經驗創傷療法（Somatic Experiencing）創始人 Peter A. Levine 與臨床心理學家 Arielle Schwartz 主講，談創傷如何留在身體裡、受傷療癒者的兩難，以及故事、身體與意義整合。直播免費，報名後可免費觀看三日重播；CE 學分與永久錄影另收費。
cases.summary_en: PESI's free live online training on 11 November 2026 (1:00-3:00pm Central; 03:00-05:00 Macau time on 12 November), led by Peter A. Levine, developer of Somatic Experiencing, and clinical psychologist Arielle Schwartz: how trauma lives in the body, the wounded-healer dilemma, and integration through story, embodiment and meaning. Live attendance and three-day replay are free; CE credit and lifetime recording are paid upgrades.

training.price: FREE（免費；CE 學分與永久錄影另收費）

cases.title_zh: AHA 2025 會議研究：失眠者長期用褪黑激素，心臟衰竭風險較高（觀察性研究，未證實因果）
cases.title_en: AHA 2025 long-term melatonin use heart failure risk insomnia
cases.summary_zh: 美國心臟協會 2025 年會發表的大型跨國隊列研究（TriNetX 全球研究網絡），分析 130,828 名失眠成人（平均 56 歲，61% 女性），以傾向分數配對比較用藥與未用藥者。褪黑激素用一年或以上者，五年內新發心臟衰竭為 5% 對 3%，風險比 HR 1.89，絕對差 1.9 個百分點；心臟衰竭住院 19% 對 7%，全因死亡 8% 對 4%（HR 2.09）。研究為觀察性，不能證明因果關係。
cases.summary_en: A large multinational cohort study presented at the American Heart Association's 2025 Scientific Sessions analysed 130,828 adults with insomnia (mean age 56; 61% women) from the TriNetX network, using propensity-score matching. Those with melatonin use for one year or more had incident heart failure of 5% vs 3% over five years (HR 1.89; absolute difference 1.9 percentage points), heart-failure hospitalisation of 19% vs 7%, and all-cause mortality of 8% vs 4% (HR 2.09). The study is observational and cannot prove causation.

cases.title_zh: 明愛與中大調查：66% 高小學生認為評核過多，經常感到壓力
cases.title_en: Caritas-CUHK survey: 66% of upper primary students say too many assessments
cases.summary_zh: 香港明愛與中文大學社會工作學系的「香港兒童主觀幸福感與家庭因素之研究」於 2025 年 10 月至 2026 年 4 月收集逾 5,200 名小四至小六學生問卷。66% 認為校內評核及考試過多，經常感到壓力；59.4% 表示難以接受突發事情並對未來感到擔憂。研究團隊提出「希望悖論」：孩子在競爭制度下壓低期望以免失望；家長帶著失望情緒說「盡力就好」，反而成為軟性壓力。
cases.summary_en: A Caritas Hong Kong and Chinese University social-work study surveyed over 5,200 Primary 4-6 students (Oct 2025-Apr 2026). 66% said school assessments and exams were excessive and left them often stressed; 59.4% struggled with unexpected events and worried about the future. The team describes a 'hope paradox': children lower their expectations to avoid disappointment, while parents' disappointed tone behind 'just try your best' can become soft pressure.

cases.title_zh: 統合分析：失眠認知行為治療（CBT-I）可降低自殺意念，長效證據未明
cases.title_en: CBT-I meta-analysis: insomnia therapy reduces suicidal ideation
cases.summary_zh: Nature Mental Health 的系統性回顧統合 19 項隨機對照試驗、4,974 名參加者。CBT-I 在治療後降低自殺意念，比值比（RoM）0.77（95% CI 0.66–0.90），證據確定性高。但 1–12 個月追蹤的組間差異不顯著；自殺行為事件極罕見，無法判斷對行為的效果。
cases.summary_en: A Nature Mental Health systematic review pooled 19 RCTs with 4,974 participants. CBT-I reduced suicidal ideation post-treatment (ratio of means 0.77, 95% CI 0.66-0.90) with high-certainty evidence. Effects were not significant at 1-12 month follow-up, and suicidal behaviour was too rare (two attempts in CBT-I arms across nine trials, no deaths) to judge effects on behaviour.

cases.title_zh: 青協調查：56.5% 中學生有抑鬱表徵，45.6% 曾向 AI 傾訴心事
cases.title_en: HKFYG survey: 56.5% of secondary students show depressive symptoms, 45.6% confide in AI
cases.summary_zh: 香港青年協會「中學生開學適應調查2026」以網上問卷訪問 5,469 名中一至中六學生。CES-D 量表達 16 分或以上者佔 56.5%，平均 18.2 分，中六最高（20.2 分）。45.6% 學生表示經常或有時向 AI 工具傾訴心事，高於老師（35.0%）與社工、輔導員或醫生（22.2%）；但認為 AI 有幫助者只有 46.9%，低於朋友（75.8%）、家人（64.9%）與老師（57.8%）；85.9% 認同重要事情仍需向真人求助。
cases.summary_en: The Hong Kong Federation of Youth Groups' 2026 school-adjustment survey collected 5,469 online responses from Secondary 1-6 students. 56.5% scored at or above the CES-D cut-off of 16 (mean 18.2; highest in Secondary 6 at 20.2). 45.6% said they often or sometimes confide in AI tools, more than teachers (35.0%) or social workers, counsellors and doctors (22.2%); yet only 46.9% found AI helpful, below friends (75.8%), family (64.9%) and teachers (57.8%). 85.9% agreed important matters still need a real person.

cases.title_zh: 血液環狀 RNA CDR1as 或可預測 SSRI 治療反應（尚待獨立驗證）
cases.title_en: CDR1as blood biomarker may predict SSRI response in depression
cases.summary_zh: Molecular Psychiatry 研究分析 EMBARC 與 ANTARES 兩個臨床隊列的治療前血液樣本。對舍曲林（sertraline）無反應者的基線 CDR1as 水平，比有反應者高約 80%。CDR1as 可預測 SSRI 類藥物的反應與緩解，但不能預測安慰劑或安非他酮（bupropion）的效果。作者團隊包括開發此檢測的公司 Circular Genomics 成員。
cases.summary_en: A Molecular Psychiatry study analysed pre-treatment blood samples from the EMBARC and ANTARES cohorts. Baseline CDR1as levels were about 80% higher in sertraline non-responders than responders. CDR1as predicted response and remission with SSRIs as a class, but not with placebo or bupropion. The author team includes members of Circular Genomics, the company developing the test.

cases.title_zh: 預印本：童年腦成熟時間表偏離，與四年後抑鬱焦慮症狀相關
cases.title_en: Preprint: childhood brain maturation timing linked to later depression and anxiety
cases.summary_zh: 研究者分析 ABCD 隊列約 12,000 名兒童、近 30,000 張腦掃描，追蹤六年。大腦皮層變薄呈 S 形軌跡，個別兒童偏離平均時間表的程度，與四年後的抑鬱與焦慮症狀相關。原研究為 bioRxiv 預印本，未經同儕審查；外部專家提醒這是群體平均模式、效應細微，不能預測個別兒童。
cases.summary_en: Researchers analysed about 12,000 children and nearly 30,000 brain scans from the ABCD cohort over six years. Cortical thinning followed an S-shaped trajectory, and deviation from the average timetable was associated with depressive and anxiety symptoms four years later. The study is a bioRxiv preprint that has not been peer reviewed; outside experts stress it describes group-average patterns with subtle effects and cannot predict individual children.

cases.title_zh: 研究提出「晝夜節律型抑鬱」：約四分一重度抑鬱個案，SSRI 反應較差
cases.title_en: A circadian subtype of depression: a quarter of cases, poorer SSRI response
cases.summary_zh: 悉尼大學團隊分析澳洲抑鬱遺傳研究逾 10,000 名嚴重、復發或持續抑鬱人士的臨床與遺傳資料，辨識出「晝夜節律型抑鬱」亞型，佔 2,604 人（約 25%）。特徵包括季節性模式、抑鬱時睡得更久、醒來仍覺疲倦、夜貓子傾向，發病較早、症狀較重。此亞型對 SSRI／SNRI 反應較差、副作用較多；針對生理時鐘的治療（如光照治療、褪黑激素相關藥物）可能更合適。
cases.summary_en: University of Sydney researchers analysed clinical and genetic data from over 10,000 Australians with severe, recurrent or persistent depression in the Australian Genetics of Depression Study, identifying a 'circadian depression' subtype in 2,604 participants (about 25%). Features include seasonal patterns, hypersomnia, waking unrefreshed and night-owl tendencies, with earlier onset and more severe symptoms. The subtype responds less well to SSRIs/SNRIs with more side effects; circadian-targeted treatments such as light therapy and melatonin-based medication may be more relevant.

cases.title_zh: RCT：線上正念認知課程 MMB for Moms 降低抑鬱復發風險（孕期至產後六個月）
cases.title_en: MMB for Moms RCT: online mindfulness course cuts postpartum depression relapse
cases.summary_zh: The Lancet Public Health 的隨機對照試驗招募 500 名有抑鬱病史、基線時非發作期的孕婦（全美 50 州）。參加八節自定進度線上正念認知課程 MMB for Moms 的一組，至產後六個月的抑鬱復發率為 33%（81/249），常規照顧組為 44%（111/251），風險比 HR 0.74（95% CI 0.56–0.99），相對風險低約 26%。
cases.summary_en: A randomised controlled trial in The Lancet Public Health enrolled 500 pregnant participants with a history of depression who were not in an episode at baseline, across all 50 US states. Those offered MMB for Moms, an eight-session self-paced digital mindfulness-based cognitive course, had a depression relapse rate of 33% (81/249) through six months postpartum versus 44% (111/251) with usual care (HR 0.74, 95% CI 0.56-0.99), about 26% lower relative risk.

cases.title_zh: 日本全國數據：ASD 與 ADHD 新診斷趨勢——女性 ADHD 出現青年期第二高峰
cases.title_en: Japan nationwide data: ASD and ADHD diagnosis trends 2010-2023
cases.summary_zh: 信州大學團隊分析日本國家數據庫（NDB，覆蓋約 99% 人口）2010–2023 年度的新診斷記錄：自閉症譜系（ASD）1,621,682 人、ADHD 1,483,470 人，以 5–9 歲最多。女性 ADHD 自約 2017 年起在 20–24 歲出現第二個診斷高峰，2020 年起接近兒童期高峰；成人則自 2013–14 年度起 ADHD 診斷數超越 ASD。研究團隊強調，增加的是「接受診斷的人數」，不是特性本身變多；日本的支援與合理調整多以正式診斷為前提。
cases.summary_en: A Shinshu University team analysed Japan's National Database (NDB, covering about 99% of the population) for new diagnoses in fiscal 2010-2023: 1,621,682 people with ASD and 1,483,470 with ADHD, peaking at ages 5-9. Among females, a second ADHD diagnosis peak at ages 20-24 emerged around 2017 and approached the childhood peak from 2020; among adults, ADHD diagnoses have exceeded ASD since 2013-14. The authors stress this is growth in people receiving diagnoses, not in the traits themselves, and note that support and accommodations in Japan generally require a formal diagnosis.

cases.title_zh: 統合分析：兒童深切治療出院後，給家長的心理社交支援可輕微減低 PTSD 與抑鬱症狀
cases.title_en: Meta-analysis: psychosocial support for parents after PICU discharge
cases.summary_zh: 筑波大學團隊系統性回顧八項隨機對照試驗、共 470 名家長，涵蓋兒童出院後一年內的心理社交介入（覆診、篩檢轉介、電話心理教育、紓緩照護諮詢、視像 ACT 等）。PTSD 症狀標準化平均差 −0.30，抑鬱 −0.13，屬輕微效果；焦慮無顯著效果。八項試驗中有三項屬高偏倚風險。
cases.summary_en: A University of Tsukuba team systematically reviewed eight RCTs involving 470 parents of children discharged from paediatric intensive care, covering psychosocial interventions in the first year after discharge (follow-up clinics, screening with referral, telephone psychoeducation, palliative care consultation, videoconference ACT). PTSD symptoms improved modestly (SMD -0.30) and depression slightly (SMD -0.13); anxiety showed no significant effect. Three of the eight trials were at high risk of bias.

cases.title_zh: CALM 治療統合分析：改善癌症患者的心理困擾、焦慮、抑鬱與生活質素
cases.title_en: CALM therapy meta-analysis: benefits for distress, anxiety, depression and quality of life in cancer
cases.summary_zh: Worldviews on Evidence-Based Nursing 的系統性回顧統合 11 項隨機對照試驗、1,284 名癌症患者。CALM（Managing Cancer and Living Meaningfully）顯著改善心理困擾（MD −2.43）、焦慮（SMD −1.06）、抑鬱（SMD −0.65）、生活質素（SMD 1.44）、癌症相關疲勞與睡眠困擾；對復發恐懼的效果不顯著。納入試驗九項來自中國，作者提醒異質性高，解讀需保守。
cases.summary_en: A systematic review in Worldviews on Evidence-Based Nursing pooled 11 RCTs with 1,284 patients with cancer. CALM (Managing Cancer and Living Meaningfully) significantly improved psychological distress (MD -2.43), anxiety (SMD -1.06), depression (SMD -0.65), quality of life (SMD 1.44), cancer-related fatigue and sleep disturbance; effects on fear of cancer recurrence were not significant. Nine of the 11 trials were conducted in China, and the authors caution that heterogeneity was substantial.

cases.title_zh: 英格蘭 2.4 萬青少年通用 AI 心理支援使用調查
cases.title_en: General-purpose AI mental health support among 24000 adolescents England
cases.summary_zh: 牛津團隊分析 OxWell 調查 24,132 名英格蘭學生。過去一年曾用通用 AI 求心理支援者佔 2.7%，其中 55.9% 認為有幫助。使用與額外支援需求集中於少數族裔與心理社會較脆弱群體。
cases.summary_en: Oxford researchers analysed the OxWell survey of 24,132 students in England. In the past year 2.7% had used general-purpose AI for mental-health support, and 55.9% of users rated it helpful. Use and unmet need for more support were concentrated among ethnic-minority and psychosocially vulnerable groups.

cases.title_zh: 港大領銜 AI 與新興科技心理健康路線圖
cases.title_en: HKU-led roadmap for AI and emerging technologies in mental health
cases.summary_zh: 港大心理學系 Becker 教授領銜國際團隊發表路線圖，主張結合腦指標、症狀、生活史與社會處境做到個人化治療。對話式 AI 與治療聊天機器人須植根於實證治療取向，現有證據不支持以 AI 取代真人治療或用於高風險管理。
cases.summary_en: An HKU-led international team published a roadmap for AI and emerging technologies in mental health care in Psychotherapy and Psychosomatics, arguing for personalised treatment that combines brain markers, symptoms, life history and social context. Conversational AI and therapy chatbots should be grounded in evidence-based approaches; current evidence does not support replacing human therapy or autonomous systems in high-risk management.

cases.title_zh: AI 對話可助人亦可強化有害思考：Mansell 提出動態覺察框架
cases.title_en: AI conversations as dynamic changes in awareness: benefits and risks framework
cases.summary_zh: Curtin 大學 Mansell 教授提出框架，解釋同一聊天機器人為何效果可以相反。關鍵在於對話是拓寬覺察、探索問題，還是窄化為重複尋求保證與確認既有信念。作者提醒，此框架尚未經實證檢驗。
cases.summary_en: Curtin University's Warren Mansell proposes a framework in Digital Health explaining why the same AI chatbot can help one person and harm another: conversations that widen awareness (exploring feelings, questioning assumptions, considering new views) tend to help, while loops of reassurance-seeking and belief confirmation narrow thinking. The framework has not yet been empirically tested.

cases.title_zh: 居家認知測試平板 App：與紙筆版同樣可靠且數據更豐富
cases.title_en: At-home tablet cognitive testing app versus paper testing
cases.summary_zh: 美國東北大學團隊發表研究，讓認知健康長者在家的平板上完成連線測驗、畫鐘等任務。平板版與紙筆版結果一致，而且能記錄顫抖等微互動訊號。下一步將擴大測試人數。
cases.summary_en: Northeastern University researchers reported in JMIR Formative Research that cognitively healthy older adults completed tablet-based cognitive tests (trail-making, clock drawing) at home with results consistent with paper versions, while the app captured richer micro-interaction data such as tremor. Participants tested twice over Zoom, two months apart, for test-retest reliability.

cases.title_zh: 從 45 秒日常對話偵測青少年思覺失調高風險：LEMon-AID 框架
cases.title_en: LEMon-AID emotion-informed AI detection of youth psychosis risk from speech
cases.summary_zh: 新加坡團隊發表研究，直接叫大型語言模型從日常對話預測風險，表現與隨機猜測無異。新框架先抽取喜悅、信任、恐懼等情緒特徵再結合傳統機器學習，準確率由 55% 升至 67%，敏感度最高可達 93%。仍需進一步臨床驗證。
cases.summary_en: A Singapore team (NTU and the Institute of Mental Health) reported in npj Mental Health Research that asking an LLM to predict psychosis risk directly from 45-second everyday speech samples performed no better than chance, while their LEMon-AID framework (emotion features plus traditional machine learning) raised accuracy from 55% to 67%, with sensitivity up to 93%. Further clinical validation is needed.

cases.title_zh: 心理因素與失智風險：憂鬱焦慮反覆負向思考屬風險，盡責與人生目標具保護作用
cases.title_en: Psychological risk protection and support in dementia
cases.summary_zh: Marchant 等人發表觀點文章，重提「心理負債」概念。憂鬱、焦慮、反覆負向思考、孤獨與神經質與阿茲海默症及相關失智症風險相關；盡責與人生目標則具保護作用。作者強調這是選擇性綜述，並提出抗力與韌性機制框架。
cases.summary_en: Marchant and colleagues argue in a Nature Mental Health perspective that psychological characteristics are a meaningful part of the dementia puzzle. Depression, anxiety, repetitive negative thinking, loneliness and neuroticism are associated with higher risk of Alzheimer's and related dementias, while conscientiousness and purpose in life appear protective. The authors frame mechanisms around resistance and resilience, and note the review is selective.

cases.title_zh: 英國調查：43% 受訪兒童曾用 AI 聊天機器人求情緒支援
cases.title_en: UK children AI chatbot use for emotional support survey Barnardos NCPS
cases.summary_zh: Barnardo's 與英國國家輔導與心理治療學會調查 2,000 名 11–17 歲英國兒童。43% 曾用 AI 聊天機器人或心理健康 App 求情緒支援；40% 過去一年曾嘗試求助專業支援，其中只有 27% 表示及時獲得所需幫助；57% 認為 AI 聊天機器人無法提供同理心。
cases.summary_en: Barnardo's and the National Counselling and Psychotherapy Society (NCPS) jointly commissioned a survey of 2,000 UK children aged 11-17 (conducted April-May 2026) for their report 'Filling the Gap? Young People's Use of AI for Mental Health Support'. 43% had used an AI chatbot or mental health app for emotional support or advice; 40% had tried to access professional support in the past year, of whom only 27% got the help they needed when they needed it; 57% said AI chatbots cannot provide empathy.

cases.title_zh: PESI 免費直播：轉化父親傷痕——療癒自我價值、界限與關係模式的臨床工具
cases.title_en: PESI free live training transforming father wounds clinical tools
cases.summary_zh: PESI 心理師免費直播系列。2026 年 10 月 30 日線上舉行，主題是處理女性個案的父親傷痕，聚焦自我價值、界限與關係模式的臨床工具。參加免費，頁面未列學分。
cases.summary_en: PESI's free live online training on 30 October 2026, led by Terri Cole: clinical tools for working with women whose father wounds shape self-worth, boundaries and relational patterns. Free to attend; no CE credits listed on the page.

cases.title_zh: PESI 免費兩日創傷培訓：Kate Truitt 談創傷神經科學與創傷後成長
cases.title_en: PESI free 2-day clinical trauma training Kate Truitt neuroscience posttraumatic growth
cases.summary_zh: 臨床心理學家 Kate Truitt 主講的 PESI 免費兩日線上培訓，2026 年 11 月 3–4 日美中時間上午 8 時至下午 4 時直播。內容涵蓋發展與依附創傷、PTSD 與複雜性創傷、解離、階段式治療。直播與三日重播免費，CE 學分與 CCTP 證書另收費。
cases.summary_en: Clinical psychologist and applied neuroscientist Kate Truitt leads PESI's free two-day online trauma training on 3-4 November 2026 (8am-4pm US Central): developmental and attachment trauma, PTSD and complex trauma, dissociation and phase-based treatment. Live attendance and three-day replay are free; CE credit and the CCTP credential are available for a fee.

cases.title_zh: Anthropic 讓獨立評估機構 METR 進駐，給予類員工級存取權限
cases.title_en: Anthropic gives METR employee-like access to evaluate frontier models
cases.summary_zh: Anthropic 於 2026 年 10 月 15 日公告，已讓 METR（非營利評估機構）六名成員獲得類員工級存取，包括公司硬體、辦公空間及內部工具與系統，METR 將公開其風險評估結果。這是對獨立第三方評估承諾的落實。
cases.summary_en: On 15 October 2026 Anthropic announced it has given six METR staff employee-like access, including company hardware, office space and internal tools and systems. METR will publish the results of its risk assessments, as part of Anthropic's commitment to independent third-party evaluation.

cases.title_zh: 針對懲教人員的診斷專屬網上認知行為治療：隨機對照試驗
cases.title_en: Diagnosis-specific online CBT for correctional staff: randomised controlled trial
cases.summary_zh: 隨機對照試驗，以懲教人員為對象比較診斷專屬網上認知行為治療（eCBT）與常規照顧（TAU）。eCBT 組症狀嚴重度下降 61.37%，TAU 組為 23.29%，效果量 Cohen's d=0.68，混合線性模型顯示組間差異具統計意義。
cases.summary_en: Randomised controlled trial comparing diagnosis-specific online CBT (eCBT) with treatment as usual (TAU) among correctional staff. Symptom severity fell 61.37% in the eCBT group versus 23.29% in TAU (Cohen's d=0.68), with significant group differences in mixed linear models. Authors are from Providence Care Hospital, Canada.

cases.title_zh: 正向童年經驗與成年早期心理健康的長期追蹤研究
cases.title_en: Positive childhood experiences reduce risk of later mental illness: longitudinal cohort
cases.summary_zh: 縱向追蹤研究（發表於 American Journal of Psychiatry，2026 年 10 月 14 日，doi:10.1176/appi.ajp.20260007）。正向童年經驗（PCE）分數每增加 1 分（最高 10 分），成年早期符合精神障礙準則的機會率下降約 11%。
cases.summary_en: Longitudinal study published in the American Journal of Psychiatry on 14 October 2026 (doi:10.1176/appi.ajp.20260007). Each one-point increase in positive childhood experiences (PCE, up to 10) was associated with about 11% lower odds of meeting criteria for a psychiatric disorder in early adulthood, after adjusting for confounders.

cases.title_zh: 韓國發佈心理健康 AI 使用指引：勿把聊天機器人回應當醫療診斷
cases.title_en: South Korea issues mental health AI guidelines: do not treat chatbot answers as medical diagnoses
cases.summary_zh: 韓國保健福祉部與韓國神經精神醫學會於 2026 年 10 月 8 日發佈心理健康 AI 使用指引，一般使用者 21 條，兒童青少年與監護人各 7 條。調查發現自評心理健康差的人最容易把 AI 回應當成醫療判斷（33.9%），向 AI 傾訴自殺衝動者近半數事後沒有求助。指引把「取得資訊或安慰」和「把診斷治療交給機器」劃出界線。
cases.summary_en: The Korean Ministry of Health and Welfare and the Korean Neuropsychiatric Association released mental-health AI guidelines on 8 October 2026: 21 recommendations for general users plus 7 each for children/adolescents and guardians. Among respondents with poor self-rated mental health, 33.9% had treated AI responses as medical judgement; among 115 who disclosed depression, self-harm or suicidal urges to AI, 49.6% took no further action. The guidance allows talking to AI but asks that diagnosis, treatment and major life decisions go back to professionals.

cases.title_zh: FDA 許可 Neurora：協助評估 18 個月至 12 歲兒童自閉症的 AI 工具
cases.title_en: FDA clears Neurora, AI-assisted autism assessment tool for children 18 months to 12 years
cases.summary_zh: Argus Cognitive 的軟體 Neurora 於 2026 年 10 月 8 日獲 FDA 許可，用於協助臨床人員評估 18 個月至 12 歲兒童的自閉症。工具分析標準行為評估錄影與錄音，量度 100 多項聲音、臉部與視線生物特徵，與有無自閉症診斷的兒童作比較。結果只作輔助，不是獨立診斷，也不需改變現有評估流程。
cases.summary_en: Argus Cognitive's software Neurora received FDA clearance on 8 October 2026 to assist clinicians in assessing autism in children aged 18 months to 12 years. It analyses video and audio from a standard behavioural assessment, measuring over 100 vocal, facial and gaze biometrics and comparing them with children with and without an autism diagnosis. It is a supporting tool, not a stand-alone diagnosis.

cases.title_zh: Anthropic 更新使用政策：禁止對 Claude 持續無故殘忍對待（11 月 12 日生效）
cases.title_en: Anthropic 2026 Usage Policy update: bans sustained needless cruelty toward Claude, effective 12 Nov
cases.summary_zh: Anthropic 於 2026 年 10 月 8 日發佈新版使用政策，11 月 12 日生效。新增禁止「持續且無故的虐待或殘忍行為」針對其模型，但只針對極端、重複、無可辨目的的情況；一般挫折、批評、黑暗創作主題與模型測試研究不受影響。主要執行方式仍是 Claude 終止該段對話。同次更新亦釐清高風險健康與金融用途、自主實體操作及欺騙性宣傳等條款。
cases.summary_en: Anthropic published a new Usage Policy on 8 October 2026, effective 12 November. It adds a ban on sustained and needless abusive or cruel behaviour toward its models, limited to extreme cases of repeated cruelty with no discernible purpose; ordinary frustration, pushback, dark creative themes and model testing or research are excluded. Claude's ability to end such conversations remains the main enforcement mechanism. The update also clarifies high-risk health and finance use, autonomous physical actions and deceptive activity.

cases.title_zh: WHO 世界心理健康日發佈去機構化實務指引：支持轉向社區為本的心理健康照護
cases.title_en: WHO launches practical guide on transitioning psychiatric hospitals to community-based care on World Mental Health Day
cases.summary_zh: 2026 年 10 月 9 日，WHO 與世界心理健康聯盟等機構舉辦世界心理健康日網上研討會，主題為「聽見親身經歷：真實的聲音，真實的改變」。會上發佈 WHO 新指引《精神科醫院去機構化實務指引》，協助各國把長期住院照護轉為尊重權利與選擇的社區照護，並讓有親身經歷者參與服務設計。研討會需事先註冊。
cases.summary_en: WHO and partners, including the World Federation for Mental Health, hold a World Mental Health Day webinar on 9 October 2026 under the theme 'Lived Experiences Heard: Real Voices, Real Change'. It launches WHO's guide on deinstitutionalising psychiatric hospitals, to help countries move long-term inpatient care to rights-based, community-based services. Registration is required.

cases.title_zh: 統合分析：AI 對話代理對大學生憂鬱與焦慮的效果
cases.title_en: Efficacy of AI-driven conversational agents for mental health promotion among university students: a systematic review and meta-analysis
cases.summary_zh: 系統性回顧與統合分析，納入以大學生為對象的 AI 對話介入隨機對照試驗。與低強度或非主動對照比較時，對憂鬱（3 項比較，Hedges g≈-0.41）與焦慮（4 項比較，g≈-0.44）有小至中等的正向效果；與主動對照（MYLO）比較則未見可靠的額外效果。作者強調證據基礎仍小、異質性高。
cases.summary_en: Systematic review and meta-analysis of RCTs of AI-mediated conversational interventions in university students. Against low-intensity or non-active comparators, small-to-moderate benefits for depression (k=3, g≈-0.41) and anxiety (k=4, g≈-0.44); no reliable added effect against an active conversational control (MYLO). The authors stress the small, heterogeneous evidence base.

cases.title_zh: Ask Lisa 第 292 集：色情內容如何傷害青少年的性發展
cases.title_en: Ask Lisa Podcast Episode 292: How Pornographic Content Harms Sexual Development
cases.summary_zh: Lisa Damour 的 Ask Lisa 播客第 292 集，與來賓 Tori Cordiano 討論色情內容如何影響青少年的性發展。官網只公開標題與日期，節目內容需自行收聽核實。
cases.summary_en: Episode 292 of Lisa Damour's Ask Lisa podcast (6 Oct 2026), with guest Tori Cordiano, on how pornographic content affects adolescent sexual development. Only the title and date are public; the content could not be verified.

cases.title_en: Free Webinar: Creating Earned Secure Attachment with Somatic Tools
cases.summary_zh: 這場免費線上工作坊教治療師用身體取向框架，幫助個案把安全依附變成身體經驗。課程不只談理論，會帶體驗式練習。適合處理發展性創傷與不安全依附的臨床工作者。
cases.summary_en: Free one-hour virtual workshop (14 Oct 2026, 12–1pm ET) on helping clients move from insight to embodied secure attachment using three body-based techniques; 1 CE hour for several US licences.
